description: Scores the answers from get_readiness_questions with fixed rules: a level from 0 to 4 per area, the rule behind each limit, the gaps found and a next step for each gap. Unanswered areas are reported as not assessed. The result is a self-assessment.

answers.description: Answers keyed by question id, each value an option id from get_readiness_questions

lang.description: Language of the result: sl, en, de or hr. Texts not yet translated are returned in English and marked in the result.

name: assess_ai_readiness
title: Assess AI readiness
